subject: Proposed evaluation sprint & success commitments — Sunrise Retail
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunriseretail.com>, Tom Bennett <tbennett@sunriseretail.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed evaluation sprint & success commitments — Sunrise Retail

Hi Olivia / Tom,

Thanks again for your time today — great to learn more about the catalog search and returns fraud workflows you're targeting. Per our call, attached is a concise 3-week evaluation sprint that will give your teams measurable signals on latency, relevance lift, and operational costs before committing to a Dedicated slot. High-level summary below; full outline attached (sunrise-eval-outline.pdf).

Goal (what success looks like)
- Demonstrate >15% NDCG improvement on catalog search query set OR reduce false-positive returns by 20% on the labeled sample.
- P95 inference latency <= 220ms for 1kQPS-equivalent batched traffic in our sandbox.
- End-to-end cost estimate and recommended serving profile.

Proposed 3-week plan (roles & ownership)
- Week 0 (prep, 3 business days) — Data handoff, access + sandbox provisioning (Owner: Marissa Cole).
  - Deliverables: sample dataset (CSV + minimal PII redaction), API keys for sandbox, initial test queries.
- Week 1 (integration, 5 business days) — Model trial integration with your staging stack (Owner: Sergio Alvarez).
  - Deliverables: quickstart notebook, initial inference throughput test, baseline metric run.
- Week 2 (evaluation, 5 business days) — Run evaluation runs, collect relevance/latency metrics (Owner: Sunrise Analytics contact).
  - Deliverables: metric dashboard (shared), token-level cost breakdown.
- Week 3 (analysis & decision, 3 business days) — Joint review, success assessment, recommendation for next steps (Owners: Laura Bennett + Marissa Cole).

Quick asks / constraints we discussed
- Sandbox will need outbound access to our staging endpoints (we'll provide IP ranges).
- Sample dataset: ~25k recent queries + labeled judgments for 2k queries preferred.
- Success threshold above is negotiable — please flag any internal KPIs we should swap in.

Action items / proposed next steps
1) Please confirm data handoff ETA (Olivia).
2) Confirm kickoff window for Week 0 (I can schedule wed/thurs next week).
3) Sergio will share a short network requirements note (attached).

If this looks good I’ll create a formal evaluation charter in HubSpot and loop in Laura (CSM) for onboarding. I’ve cc’d Vivek (Sales Manager) to expedite any trial credits / contract questions.

Attachments: sunrise-eval-outline.pdf

Cheers,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference for product teams
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunriseretail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tbennett@sunriseretail.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation sprint & success commitments — Sunrise Retail

Marissa — thanks for the clear plan and the outline. A few quick clarifications before we lock dates:

- Data: We can provide the 25k query sample but need to confirm a redaction approach for customer PII. Do you have recommended scripts or a sample pipeline?
- Sandbox access: Are we going to use a VPN or IP allowlist? Our security team prefers not to open broad egress.
- Duration: Is 3 weeks a firm timeline? Our analytics team prefers a 4-week window to run a second pass of relevance judgments.
- Trial credits: Any guidance on potential credits or cost exposure if we exceed the sandbox quota during stress tests?

Happy to do a quick sync Wed AM to review.

—Olivia
Olivia Park
Head of Search & Personalization | Sunrise Retail
olivia.park@sunriseretail.com | +1 (646) 555-0145
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunriseretail.com>, Tom Bennett <tbennett@sunriseretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation sprint & success commitments — Sunrise Retail

Hi Olivia — quick answers to the technical points, and a couple of suggestions to keep the sprint tight. I’ve attached a concise network/reqs file.

- PII redaction: we typically provide a small Python script (regex + column mask) that you can run locally before upload — this filters emails, phone numbers, and account IDs. If you prefer, we can run the scrub on your behalf inside a secure transfer channel (SFTP).
- Network: IP allowlist is the preferred path. We will provide three static egress IPs for sandbox access; no VPN required. If your infra requires a VPN, we can support it but it adds ~2 business days for setup.
- Timeline: 3 weeks is our minimum to get meaningful metrics, but a 4-week window is fine if you want an additional judgment pass; we'd adjust deliverables in Week 3 accordingly.
- Trial credits / quotas: For the sandbox we’ll cover up to 1M inference tokens at no charge for the evaluation; beyond that we’ll provide a discounted overage rate. Vivek can confirm specifics.

Operational notes:
- Suggested initial model and config: redwood-small-quant (fast path) with 4-token warm cache TTL for search-style prompts. Should give low latency and representative cost numbers.
- Sample payload: start with 1k-batch runs to validate shaping then scale to 5k for cost/throughput profiles.

Attachment: network-requirements.txt

If you confirm the data handoff ETA, I can prepare the quickstart notebook and a reproducible eval script for your analytics team.

Thanks,
Sergio
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@sunriseretail.com>, Tom Bennett <tbennett@sunriseretail.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed evaluation sprint & success commitments — Sunrise Retail

Thanks Olivia — great questions, and appreciate the preference for a safety-first approach on data and network. Quick replies inline and next steps below.

- Redaction: We’ll send the small Python redaction script (Sergio — can you drop that into the shared Drive link?) and an example notebook for running locally. If Sunrise prefers, we can accept an SFTP transfer and perform the scrub on our side; let me know which you prefer.
- Network: We will provide the three sandbox IPs in a follow-up from Sergio; IP allowlist is our recommended pattern and avoids VPN complexity.
- Timeline: We’re flexible — if you want 4 calendar weeks we’re happy to extend Week 2 for the second judgment pass. Please confirm which you prefer when you confirm the data ETA.
- Credits: Vivek — can you confirm the sandbox credit policy and any one-time overage discount we can offer for this eval?

Proposed near-term schedule (choose one kickoff window)
- Option A: Wed 17 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT — prep + provisioning call
- Option B: Thu 18 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PT — prep + provisioning call

If either works I’ll send a calendar invite and create the HubSpot evaluation charter (link above) with owners and deliverables. Once we have your go-ahead on data handoff I’ll mark Week 0 as started and Sergio will push the quickstart materials.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting this rolling.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
